Henan's lab-grown diamond exports more than double year on year, as Zhengzhou unveils China's first province-level growth plan.

Officials say exports reached 15.8 million carats in nine months, with Zhengzhou ranking first nationally by value; the city targets a 20-billion-yuan industry by 2028.

河南培育鑽石出口量首九個月同比增長116%，達1580萬克拉，鄭州出口貨值全國第一；當地公布2026至2028年行動方案，力爭到2028年全產業規模達200億元人民幣。

A 131-year-old mainland jeweller is delisted from the Shenzhen exchange, after missing its 2025 annual report.

Cuihua Jewelry's last trading day was 12 November; earlier in 2026 it had 45 bank accounts frozen, a 254-million-yuan overdue loan, and a CSRC fraud investigation.

百年金飾品牌萃華珠寶因未按時發布年報，於深圳交易所退市；之前曾遭凍結45個銀行帳戶、借款逾期2.54億人民幣，並獲中國證監會立案調查。
